BiblicalUsage: Sarak is paths crossing and winding back on themselves, like a track worn by feet going every way at once. Judah is called a swift dromedary traversing her ways, and told to look at the valley and know what she has done.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a winding path always leaves tracks, and God reads the trail even when I claim I never went that way.
